title: Density Formula
text: Density is mass per unit volume: $$\rho=\frac{m}{V}, $$ where $$\rho$$ is the density, $$m$$ is the mass, and $$V$$ is the volume occupied by the substance.

title: Identify the Density of Gasoline
text: The density of gasoline is approximately $$680\,\text{kg/m}**3,$$ and the density of steel is approximately $$7.80\times10**{3}\,\text{kg/m}**3.$$ Convert the volume of gasoline from $$20.0\, \text{L}$$ to cubic meters.

title: Calculate the Total Mass
text: The total mass of the full gas can is the sum of the mass of the can and the mass of the gasoline: $$m_{\text{total}}=m_{c}+m_{g}.$$ What is the total mass (in $$\text{kg})$$?

title: Find the Total Volume and the Average Density
text: The total volume is the volume of the gasoline plus the volume of the steel, $$V_{\text{steel}}=\frac{m_{c}}{\rho_{\text{steel}}}.$$ The average density is $$\rho=\frac{m_{\text{total}}}{V_{\text{total}}}$$.
